subject: english
question: Select the sentence that contains a spelling error.

options.text: Researchers recommend that pesticides should not be used indiscriminately as they eliminate biodiversity for future generations.
Journalism is often the work of painstaking rigour and perseverence that detail the socio-political experiences of our worlds.
The venerated singer was also secretive, moody and very intense, famous for erratic and difficult behaviour.
Elephants are in trouble mainly because people desire ivory trinkets that are made of tusks, often gruesomely killing them to achieve their purpose.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"perseverence"** is a misspelling of the correct word "perseverance", which means persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success. (दृढ़ता)

 
 
• **Example:** His perseverance in studying for the exams finally paid off when he topped the class.
 
 
 
• **"Perseverance"** refers to the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties. (दृढ़ता)
 
 
• **Example:** The athlete's perseverance earned her a gold medal in the competition.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 1:** Researchers recommend that pesticides should not be used indiscriminately as they eliminate biodiversity for future generations. (अनुसंधानकर्ताओं ने अनुशंसा की है कि कीटनाशकों का अंधाधुंध उपयोग नहीं किया जाना चाहिए क्योंकि वे भविष्य की पीढ़ियों के लिए जैव विविधता को समाप्त कर देते हैं।)
 
• **Option 3:** The venerated singer was also secretive, moody and very intense, famous for erratic and difficult behaviour. (सम्मानित गायक भी गुप्त, मूडी और बहुत तीव्र थे, अराजक और कठिन व्यवहार के लिए प्रसिद्ध थे।)
 
• **Option 4:** Elephants are in trouble mainly because people desire ivory trinkets that are made of tusks, often gruesomely killing them to achieve their purpose. (हाथी मुख्य रूप से इस कारण मुसीबत में हैं क्योंकि लोग हाथीदांत की छोटी-छोटी चीजों की इच्छा रखते हैं जो दांतों से बनाई जाती हैं, अक्सर उन्हें अपने उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए भयानक रूप से मार डालते हैं।)
